data.one_liner: Plugin to set wallpaper on Android devices
data.what_it_does: Allows setting home, lock, or both screen wallpapers from a file path and clearing wallpapers.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, request WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission if needed
data.minimal_example:
int location = WallpaperManager.BOTH_SCREEN;
bool result = await WallpaperManager.setWallpaperFromFile(path, location);
